stem.en: Not until the final results were published ___ how close the vote had been.

why.en: After a fronted 'Not until …' clause, the main clause takes question word order: did the public learn.
why.uz: Gap «Not until …» bilan boshlansa, bosh gapda soʻroq tartibi ishlatiladi: did the public learn.
why.ru: Если предложение начинается с «Not until …», в главной части нужен вопросительный порядок слов: did the public learn.

stem.en: If she had accepted the job in Seoul last year, she ___ in Korea now.

why.en: A past condition with a present result is a mixed conditional: if + past perfect, then would + verb (would be living now).
why.uz: Oʻtgan zamondagi shart va hozirgi natija — aralash shart gap: if + past perfect, keyin would + feʼl (would be living now).
why.ru: Условие в прошлом с результатом в настоящем — смешанное условное: if + past perfect, затем would + глагол (would be living now).

stem.en: We ___ so much food: half the guests cancelled, and most of it was left over.

why.en: 'Needn't have + past participle' means something was done but turned out to be unnecessary.
why.uz: «Needn't have + past participle» ish bajarilganini, lekin keraksiz boʻlib chiqqanini bildiradi.
why.ru: «Needn't have + причастие прошедшего времени» означает, что действие совершили, но оно оказалось ненужным.

why.ru: О прошлом событии, о котором говорят сейчас, используют «is thought to have been + причастие».

stem.en: Anyone ___ to join the trip should sign up at the office by Friday.

why.en: A present participle can shorten a relative clause: anyone wishing = anyone who wishes.
why.uz: Hozirgi zamon sifatdoshi nisbiy gapni qisqartiradi: anyone wishing = anyone who wishes.
why.ru: Причастие на -ing сокращает определительное придаточное: anyone wishing = anyone who wishes.

why.en: 'Having + past participle' shows an action finished before the main one, with the same subject (she).

why.ru: «Having + причастие» обозначает действие, завершённое до основного, с тем же подлежащим (she).

stem.en: It is essential that every applicant ___ the form before the deadline.

why.en: After 'It is essential that', formal English uses the base form of the verb: every applicant submit.
why.uz: «It is essential that» dan keyin rasmiy ingliz tilida feʼlning asosiy shakli keladi: every applicant submit.
why.ru: После «It is essential that» в официальном английском ставится глагол в начальной форме: every applicant submit.

stem.en:
Lola had expected the job to be dull, yet she found herself staying late most evenings, reluctant to leave unfinished work behind.
What does the text suggest about Lola?

options.en: She enjoyed the work more than expected.
Her manager made her stay late every evening.
She found the job as dull as she had feared.
She usually left her work unfinished in the evenings.

why.en: 'Yet' contrasts what she expected (dull) with what happened: she stayed late by choice.
why.uz: «Yet» kutilgan narsani (zerikarli) boʻlgan voqeaga qarshi qoʻyadi: u oʻz xohishi bilan kech qolgan.
why.ru: «Yet» противопоставляет ожидание (скучно) тому, что произошло: она сама задерживалась допоздна.

stem.en:
The museum's new wing, praised by architects, has proved less popular with visitors, who complain that its signs are hard to follow.
What is the visitors' main criticism?

options.en: It is hard to find your way around.
The design of the building is unattractive.
The tickets for the new wing are too expensive.
The rooms are often far too crowded.

why.en: Visitors 'complain that its signs are hard to follow', so they struggle to find their way.
why.uz: Tashrif buyuruvchilar yoʻl koʻrsatkichlarini tushunish qiyinligidan shikoyat qiladi, yaʼni yoʻlni topish qiyin.
why.ru: Посетители жалуются, что указатели трудно понять, то есть сложно ориентироваться.

stem.en:
Far from discouraging Amir, the rejection letter made him determined to improve his portfolio and apply again.
How did Amir react to the rejection?

options.en: It made him give up his plans.
It persuaded him to change careers.
It did not affect him at all.

why.en: 'Far from discouraging' means it had the opposite effect: he became more determined.
why.uz: «Far from discouraging» teskari taʼsirni bildiradi: rad javobi uni yanada qatʼiyatli qildi.
why.ru: «Far from discouraging» означает обратный эффект: отказ сделал его ещё решительнее.

stem.en:
The council insists the new bus lanes have reduced journey times, though drivers who use the main road every day see little difference.
What does the text imply?

options.en: Daily drivers' experience does not match the council's claim.
The council accepts that drivers have seen little benefit.
Daily drivers report that their journeys have become slower.
Many daily drivers have switched to taking the bus instead.

why.en: The council 'insists' journey times fell, 'though' daily drivers 'see little difference': their experience does not match the claim. The council concedes nothing, and nobody says journeys got slower.
why.uz: Kengash yoʻl vaqti qisqarganini taʼkidlaydi, lekin har kuni yuradigan haydovchilar deyarli farq sezmaydi: ularning tajribasi kengash daʼvosiga mos kelmaydi. Kengash buni tan olmaydi, yoʻl sekinlashgani ham aytilmagan.
why.ru: Совет «настаивает», что время в пути сократилось, но водители почти не видят разницы: их опыт не совпадает с заявлением совета. Совет этого не признаёт, а о замедлении никто не говорит.
